description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the performance of various models by comparing their "Accuracy / Correlation" across different evaluation metrics. The horizontal category axis displays five distinct groups, with the rightmost three explicitly labeled as "Unsupervised_SimCSE", "Supervised_SimCSE", and "2-Tier SimCSE", while the first two groups on the left lack visible labels. The vertical value axis, labeled "Accuracy / Correlation", employs a linear scale with a visible range starting below 0.2 and extending above 0.9, featuring major tick marks at intervals of 0.2 and minor tick marks every 0.04. The data is visualized using grouped bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of three adjacent bars. According to the legend positioned at the top, these bars represent different metrics: "Sentiment Acc." is depicted in light beige, "STS Corr." in pink, and "Paraphrase Acc." in light blue. Within each group, the bars are arranged in this exact order from left to right. The shortest bar in the chart is the light beige "Sentiment Acc." bar in the first unlabeled group, with an approximate value of 0.45, while the tallest bar is the light blue "Paraphrase Acc." bar in the "2-Tier SimCSE" group, reaching an approximate value of 0.90. Consistently across all groups, the light blue "Paraphrase Acc." bar is the tallest, followed by the pink "STS Corr." bar, with the light beige "Sentiment Acc." bar being the shortest. The chart is rendered with a tilted perspective, and the categories appear to be sorted in ascending order based on their overall metric values from left to right, with no individual bars visually emphasized through additional shading or outlines.
